snov_prison.updateNotes: A prison break now keeps the prison in lockdown until a warden repairs it, and admins can end a lockdown with /repairprison. A broken broom now stops the yard shift until the inmate fetches a new one.

snov_stretcher.updateNotes: All stretcher texts are now translatable, with English and German included. Unconscious patients now stay on the stretcher instead of falling through the world.

snov_importcars.updateNotes: The dealership now runs on plain ESX with every other integration optional, and ships in English and German. When updating, keep your current job and account settings.

snov_cuffs.updateNotes: Distances, item names, controls, the handcuff model and who may restrain are now adjustable in an editable config file. The weapon wheel is now blocked while restrained, and escorting takes the escort's weapons away.

snov_sperrzone.updateNotes: Zones now clear NPCs automatically and can be set up per zone type.

snov_jobs.updateNotes: Job, boss and admin menus are now available in English and German, and Snov Banking & Billing is now optional. Install together with snov_banking_billing 1.2.0.

snov_farming.updateNotes: Depleted farming zones now show a clear message instead of a generic error. Hidden skills no longer appear in the skills menu.

snov_evidence.updateNotes: Evidence without a serial number — ammunition, drugs, documents and plain items — can be sealed and stored again instead of being handed back to the officer. A fingerprint or DNA match on an unidentified person now resolves the name instead of leaving it unknown.

snov_license.updateNotes: Weapon training at Ammu-Nation is now a written theory exam instead of a simple purchase, graded on the spot with a result breakdown and a non-refundable attempt fee. Passing issues an official stamped certificate into the citizen's inventory, and an NPC reprints lost copies.

snov_mdt.updateNotes: Adds a bridge to snov_prison: the booking terminal can show what a person still has to serve, mark a sentence as served and pull the inmate photo.

snov_banking_billing.updateNotes: Banking is now available in English and German and runs without Snov Jobs. Install together with snov_jobs 2.9.0.

snov_documents.updateNotes: Filing cabinets and mailboxes are rebuilt with named compartments, drag to sort, search across the whole cabinet and one-button deposit. Adds citations as their own paper type and a global power-of-attorney template. Install together with snov_mdt 1.6.0 or newer.
